At the birthday party
Favourite present → What is your favourite...?
Congratulating → Expressions (Happy birthday, Congratulations)
Talking about gifts → Past Simple (I got a present)
Eating out – 1. Organizing picnic → Let’s..., Shall we...?
2. The best place to eat → Superlatives (the best, the cheapest)
3. Picnic vocabulary → Food & drinks. Grammar focus: Prepositions of place – on, under, behind
4. Talking about weather → It’s sunny, It’s cloudy
Exam preparation Reviewing grammar (Present, Past, Future)
Common exam topics (Family, Travel, Food, Health). Final work
Language Learning
Talking about subjects → Like/Don’t like + ing (I like learning English)
I Can Speak English – Listening: Conversation on the Telephone
Talking about goals → Future “going to” (I am going to study English hard)
Post Office & Telecommunication (Watching Video)
Directions → Imperatives (Go straight, Turn left)
Post office services → Countable/uncountable nouns (a letter, some stamps)
Telecommunication → Present Continuous (I am calling, She is sending a message)
Mass media 1. Types of mass media → Vocabulary practice (radio, TV, newspaper, internet)
Reading newspapers → Present Simple (I read the newspaper every morning)
Watching TV → Adverbs of frequency (always, often, sometimes, never)
Using the internet → Can for ability (I can find information online)
Comparing media → Comparatives & superlatives (TV is more popular than radio)
At the hotel 1. Making a reservation → Polite requests (Can I book...? I would like...)
Hotel facilities → There is/are (There is a swimming pool, There are many rooms)
Room service → Imperatives (Please bring..., Call...)
Complaints → Should/Shouldn’t (You should clean the room)
City and country 1. Living in the city → Present Simple (I live in Tashkent)
Country life → Past Simple (I lived in a village when I was a child)
Comparing city and country → Comparatives (The city is bigger than the village)
Weather and climate 1. Describing today’s weather → Present Continuous (It is raining, The sun is shining)
Talking about seasons → Present Simple (Winter is cold, Summer is hot)
Climate change → Future “will” (The weather will change tomorrow). Grammar: go home / go to work / go to the cinema. Skill Focus: Writing a paragraph
Talking about habits → Adverbs of frequency (It often rains in autumn). Skill Focus: Writing a paragraph
Ceremony 1. Anniversary → Past Simple (We celebrated our anniversary last year)
Birthday → Future “going to” (I am going to invite my friends)
Weddings → Present Simple (People get married in summer)
Celebrations → Expressions (Congratulations, Best wishes, Happy holiday)
My favourite book → Wh-questions (What is your favourite book?)
Types of Books. Writing Instruction for Devices
Reading habits → Present Simple (I read books every evening)
Comparing books → Comparatives (This book is more interesting than that one)
Personality Appearance → Adjectives (tall, short, beautiful, strong)
Characters (in books, films, stories)
Education System Schools in Uzbekistan → Present Simple (Students study math, English
University life → Future “going to” (I am going to study at university)
Distance Learning – Writing a Paragraph about Online Learning
Subjects → Wh-questions (What subject do you like?)
Talking about teachers → Have got / Has got (We have got good teachers)
Comparing education → Comparatives (Education today is better than in the past)
Healthy lifestyle 1. Keeping on a diet → Should/Shouldn’t (You should eat vegetables)
2. Eating healthy food → Countable/uncountable nouns (an apple, some milk)
Exercise → Can for ability (I can run, I can swim)
Daily routine → Present Simple (I go jogging every morning)
Famous people 1. Uzbek famous people → Past Simple (He was born in Samarkand, She wrote books)
Talking about achievements → Present Perfect (He has won many awards)
Asking about people → Wh-questions (Who is he? What did she do?)
Exam preparation 1. Grammar review → Present, Past, Future tenses
2. Speaking practice → Common topics (Family, Books, City, Weather, Health)
3. Writing practice → Simple sentences & short paragraphs. Final work
